scenarios.description: Verify registered preference ownership, Settings navigation and save acknowledgements.
scenarios.userEntryPoint: Open Settings, navigate to Permissions or Labs, and change a switch. Check the result and recover from a refused change.
prerequisites: Node 22, the locked frontend and dependency policy packages, Electron and Xvfb.
A candidate checkout with its normal Settings renderer build.
expectedEvidence: The catalog and production access checker passes. Negative fixtures reject invalid paths and writes.
Electron fixtures report successful navigation, keyboard changes, save acknowledgement and recovery.
limits: The Electron parent is synthetic. Native CLI readback, OS effects and installer behavior require separate checks.
